These are internal constructions; no worldwide novelty or independent external validation is claimed.

## Strongest mathematical deduction

[ROBUST_PROGRESSIONS.md](</Users/harjas/Documents/ChatGPT/Literature Digestion/notes/frontier_combin1/cycle19/ROBUST_PROGRESSIONS.md>) supplies a complete general finite sparse-repair lemma.
